subject: Refactor Dockerfile to Reduce Image Layers and Size (#679)
reason: The change modifies only .devcontainer/Dockerfile, merging apt install steps into fewer layers and cleaning caches to shrink the dev-container image. It is purely a build/CI environment change: no module source, command handling, indexing, replication or persistence code changes, so the loaded valkey-search module behaves identically on both builds and there is nothing a runtime scenario could reach.
